ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Beattie wants to walk from $P$ to $Q$ along the paths shown, always moving in the direction from $P$ to $Q$.
<image1>
She will add the numbers on the paths she walks along. How many different totals could she obtain?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the route from P to Q proceeds in the direction from left to right, and there are three consecutive choice sections in total, each section has only two optional paths, upper and lower, and the three sections are respectively labeled 1 and 2, 3 and 4, 5 and 6. Then reason: because one must always proceed from P to Q, each time one passes through a section, one must choose one of the two paths in that section, so the total is the sum obtained by taking one number from each of {1,2}, {3,4}, {5,6}. The minimum total is 1+3+5=9, and changing the choice to the other path in each section increases the total by 1, so the possible totals are successively 9, 10, 11, 12, for a total of 4 different totals.

raw_record.question_text: Beattie wants to walk from P to Q along the paths shown, always moving in the direction from P to Q. She will add the numbers on the paths she walks along. How many different totals could she obtain?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as three left-to-right choice sections in series: first Beattie must take either the path labeled 1 or 2, then either 3 or 4, then either 5 or 6 before reaching Q. From the text, she adds the numbers on the paths she walks and only moves from P toward Q. Enumerate or combine the possible sums: choose one from each pair, so totals are from {1,2}+{3,4}+{5,6}. The smallest is 1+3+5=9 and each choice can increase the total by 0 or 1 in each of the three sections, giving possible totals 9, 10, 11, and 12. Therefore there are 4 different totals.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中从 P 到 Q 的路线是按从左到右的方向前进，共有三段连续的选择区，每一段都只有上下两条可选路径，三段分别标着 1 和 2、3 和 4、5 和 6。再推理：因为必须一直朝 P 到 Q 前进，所以每次经过一段都要在该段的两条路径中选一条，因此总和就是从 {1,2}、{3,4}、{5,6} 中各取一个数相加。最小总和是 1+3+5=9，而每一段改选另一条路都会使总和增加 1，所以可能的总和依次是 9、10、11、12，一共 4 个不同的总和。

planner_metadata.text_role: The text supplies the movement rule, that Beattie always moves from P to Q, and the scoring rule, that she adds the numbers on the paths she walks.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use finite enumeration/set addition: when one option is chosen from each of several independent pairs, the possible totals are all sums formed by selecting one number from each pair, then count distinct values.
